crossRefs.note: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
“ ‘ “The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the chief of all spices, and…
The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.
“ ‘ “The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and…

parallels.note: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

people.name: Cush
people.line: Son of Ham; father of Nimrod and other descendants

people.name: Dedan
people.line: Grandson of Cush, son of Raamah

people.name: Havilah
people.line: A son of Cush, descendant of Ham.

people.name: Raamah
people.line: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham, great-grandson of Noah

people.name: Sabtah
people.line: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham

people.name: Sabteca
people.line: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham

people.name: Seba
people.line: Son of Cush, brother of Raamah

people.name: Sheba
people.line: Descendants of Cush, known for wealth and trade

translations.web: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
translations.bsb: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
translations.asv: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.
